text:
Ava: Quick proposal: run a tight PLG experiment next week that bundles a short benchmark narrative, a 25-min 'how we measured it' webinar, and a 3-day starter-credit drip with a downloadable prompt-template pack. Goal: +15% activation (first successful generation) and improved demo→paid conversion.

Jamal: Sounds good. Webinar should show concrete p50/p95 numbers vs one major competitor. Engineers respond to the data. :bar_chart:

Priya: Agree. Keep messaging product-led not salesy. Tentative webinar title: 'Predictable costs & latency: micro-benchmarks that matter'. I'll prepare 3 prompt packs (productivity, support, search).

Luca: Routing question: give all registrants starter credits up front (150 tokens) and award an extra 150 for attendees. Also A/B test immediate credits vs. credits-after-attend.

Ava: Proposed flow: signup -> 150 tokens + prompt pack link; attend -> +150 tokens + invitation to prompt workshop; 48h nudges with onboarding checklist. We'll A/B test the incentive framing (credits-first vs templates-first).

Maya: Two microcopy variants for signup CTA: Variant A (credits-first): 'Get 150 starter tokens + 3 ready prompts. Join the live demo to double your credits.' Variant B (templates-first): 'Start building with 3 curated prompts and 150 tokens—see real latency & cost wins live.' I'll prep email cadence drafts.

campaign-bot: Created campaign tags: `microweb_apr_experiment` and `microweb_variant_test`. Registration opens in 36h. Reminders queued: -48h, -24h, -1h, +1h.

Jamal: Sharing perf sheet: https://redwood.internal/perf/apr-microweb (internal). Priya, use the 'slides' tab for p95/p50 charts. We'll compare quantized 13B variant vs baseline.

Priya: I'll make two slide charts (chat p50/p95, batch embed throughput + cost per 1k tokens). Need a tiny quote from a pilot app if possible.

Luca: Engineering: can we ship a one-click import for prompt packs into Playground? That should cut time-to-first-success. Jamal?

Jamal: Yes, import hook ready. Simple manifest accepted, e.g.:
```
{
 "name": "support-quickstart",
 "prompts": ["Summarize ticket", "Draft reply"]
}
```
We can enable for experiment.

Priya: Action items: Ava — finalize brief + KPIs. Maya — email + microcopy variants. Jamal — perf sheet + import hook final. Luca — in-app banner + import flow. Priya — slides + prompt packs. Sync 20m tomorrow.

Ava: Calendar invite set for 09:30 PT. Launch window: Apr 7–14 mini-experiment. Keep it small and measurable. :rocket:

Maya: I'll prepare subject lines and a short GIF demo for the in-app banner.

Jamal: I'll set up attribution tags and a Looker funnel: first_generation -> first_success -> paid. Aim for ~2.5k registrants for power.

Ava: Thanks everyone. Drop copy before 5pm today if you want edits. Excited to see if the credit + template nudge moves activation. :sparkles:
